fields.tag: Unique identifier for the equipment or instrument
fields.equipment: Name of the industrial asset or component
fields.unit: Unit of measurement for the parameter
fields.action_remarks: Narrative description of the trigger and resulting action
fields.action: The required or automatic response to a condition
fields.confined_space_entry_digester_tanks: Specific digester tanks designated as confined spaces
fields.trigger: The specific event or threshold that initiates a response
fields.requirement: The mandatory action or standard to be met
fields.condition: The state or circumstance under which a rule applies

fields.logging: The specific notification or event to be logged

fields.display_message: The text displayed on the HMI or control screen
fields.h2s_scrubber_media_replacement: Identifier for the scrubber requiring media replacement
fields.status: The operational state of the equipment
fields.boiler_service_interval: Identifier for the boiler service tracking
fields.reminder: The notification issued prior to a deadline
fields.flare_ignition_test: The system or component being tested for ignition
fields.frequency: How often a task must be performed
fields.logging_requirement: The specific data that must be recorded in logs
fields.classification: The safety or operational category of the area/task
fields.permit: The requirement status of a work permit
fields.limits: The acceptable range of values for entry or operation
fields.personnel_requirement: The staffing requirements for a task
fields.entry_supervisor_duty: The specific responsibilities of the entry supervisor
fields.gas_holder_platform_access: The specific access point or platform
fields.restriction: The nature of the access prohibition
fields.indicator: The visual or audible signal indicating a state
fields.flare_area_exclusion: Identifier for the flare exclusion zone
fields.exclusion_zone: The physical dimensions of the restricted area
